title: LookQuality
description: Data file content/look/quality.json: quality levels (B2 R30) and how the sun's shadow is rendered at each shadow quality. Which level a hardware tier uses is decided in B7. Values are placeholders until the benchmark (acceptance 5) has measured them.

grass_density.description: Grass instances relative to the full density (0..1).

grass_distance_m.description: Distance up to which grass is drawn.

shadows.description: Shadow quality: off = the sun casts no shadow; low and high are rendered as shadow_settings says.

outline.description: Outline method of the comic style: off = no ink outline on objects and figures; inverted_hull = the hull pass; post_process is not built yet and is drawn as inverted_hull.

ShadowSettings.description: How the sun's shadow is rendered at the shadow qualities a level can name (off needs none).

ShadowRendering.description: Rendering of the sun's shadow at one shadow quality (the softness of the edges is look data: daylight.json shadow_blur).

max_distance_m.description: Distance from the camera up to which shadows are drawn (they fade out before it).

atlas_size.description: Edge length of the directional shadow map in pixels (shared by the splits).

mode.description: How the view is split into shadow maps: one map (cheapest, softer up close), two or four splits.

soft_filter.description: Filter quality of the shadow edges (hard = no filtering; a higher quality is smoother and costs more).
